turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
they’re handled differently. A normal return or exchange isn’t accepted because all sales are final, but a damaged item can be reviewed under the warranty process.

You’ll need to provide a photo of the damaged item and the order details. If the claim qualifies, the outcome is a replacement when available or store credit for the amount paid. Refunds aren’t offered for defective items.

Please send the email address used at checkout so we can continue with your claim 💖

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
.

The claim must have one outcome for all affected items: either a replacement for all eligible items or store credit for all affected items. We can’t replace some items and credit others. If any affected item is out of stock, store credit is issued instead of offering a choice. Refunds aren’t offered for defective items.

Please submit the claim at https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/ using the email or phone number on your order, and send the checkout email here too 💖

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
If an approved replacement also arrives damaged, it would need a fresh photo and closer review rather than an automatic second replacement or store credit. A replacement that has already been issued is checked before another remedy is considered.

Please submit the new issue through https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/ with a clear photo, using the email or phone number on the order 💖
